head: TTStickers: WhatsApp sticker maker turns videos into animated stickers
dek: TTStickers is a free iPhone and iPad app that turns your videos and photos into animated or still stickers and adds them to WhatsApp. It came out on 18 November and was #75 in free Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 26 November.
details: You can trim a clip, frame it, add text and build packs of 3 to 30 stickers. Stickers are private unless you choose to share them; shared ones go through a content filter. Signing in is only needed to publish or rank stickers. The maker, LDX Software, says the app isn't affiliated with WhatsApp.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 or later), free
means: If you want stickers from your own clips in WhatsApp chats, this app makes them on your phone.
todo: Keep your stickers private unless you're happy for others to see them; sharing is your choice.
